name: Large 4D Gaussian Model (L4GM)
definition: A feed-forward 4D large reconstruction model that outputs per-frame 3DGS from a single-view video in one ~1s forward pass, upsampling to higher fps via temporal self-attention.
summary: L4GM is a feed-forward model that generates per-frame 3D Gaussian Splatting from single-view video in one second, enabling dynamic scene reconstruction without iterative optimization.
